what: Put two things in your password manager, in one item: the age private key at ~/.config/prospector/age-key.txt, and the R2 read credentials (R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) for the prospector-backup bucket.
why_founder: It is a physical act with two secret values, and no agent may copy a secret anywhere it can be read again. This is the only item on the list and it takes one visit.
unblocks: Recovering the estate after losing this laptop. The encrypted store now has a second copy in the R2 backup bucket, but the two credentials needed to use it both live only on this machine: the key opens the store, and the R2 credentials fetch it. They are also INSIDE the store, so recovering either one alone is a dead end - the key with no way to reach the file, or the file with no way to read it.

what: Send one photo + caption to the estate Telegram bot from your phone.
why_founder: CP1 (crew#284) requires a real photo from the founder's own camera/phone through the Telegram -> intake/vision.py -> DOC_COMMIT path. No agent may take or send a photo pretending to be the founder.
unblocks: crew#284 CP1 (Telegram -> kernel checkpoint) and CP2 depends on CP1's receipt existing for the full spec chain to close.
done_when: gh issue view 284 --repo chidionyema/crew --json comments -q '.comments[].body' | grep -qE 'DOC_COMMIT[[:space:]]+[0-9a-f]{7,40}'

what: System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Full Disk Access -> + -> add /usr/bin/python3 (Cmd+Shift+G to paste the path) -> toggle ON.
why_founder: TCC (Apple's permission system) grants are per-exact-binary and only settable via a GUI dialog. No agent/CLI can grant this. Traced 2026-08-26: launchd job com.founder.estatewatch calls /usr/bin/python3 (Apple system Python 3.9.6), which writes to ~/.hermes/state/telegram_sent.jsonl and fails with PermissionError every ~8 minutes without it. A prior attempt granted the WRONG binary (Homebrew python3.14) because the fix wasn't traced to the exact caller first.
unblocks: crew#296 (telegram_ledger.py recurring PermissionError, silently breaking the estate alert delivery path every cycle).
done_when: test $(($(date +%s) - $(stat -f %m ~/.hermes/state/telegram_sent.jsonl 2>/dev/null || echo 0))) -lt 3600 && ! grep -q 'telegram_ledger.*Operation not permitted' <(tail -100 ~/.claude/ESTATE_BOARD.jsonl 2>/dev/null | tail -20)
